About Zhu’s Scalp Acupuncture

A clinical system, not a collection of scalp points.

ZSA is presented here as a structured clinical approach developed by Professor Ming Qing Zhu, emphasizing assessment, treatment strategy, immediate functional reassessment and Dao Yin.

01

Assessment before needling

Begin with the functional presentation and define what can be reassessed.

02

Treatment zones within a system

Location and technique are linked to the clinical problem rather than memorized in isolation.

03

Immediate reassessment

Clinical response is repeatedly observed during treatment.

04

Dao Yin

Guided movement and active participation are integrated with needling and reassessment.
